'''Voshpar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Republic Army]]'s [[301st Infantry]]. In [[3642 BBY]], during the [[Battle of Hoth (Galactic War)|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], Private Voshpar was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Fideltin Rusk]]'s new unit after the sergeant's previous [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was lost in combat. Voshpar served alongside Privates [[Edder]], [[Reico]], [[Dromol]], and [[Vanth]] as Rusk's squad aided the [[Hero of Tython]] and [[Leeha Narezz]] in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] search for the plans to the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Fortress|space fortress]].
